meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Belize (unitary national jurisdiction; International Business Company regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law - English common law, equity and parliamentary statute; original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Belize, intermediate appellate jurisdiction of the Court of Appeal, and final appellate jurisdiction of the Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ) since 2010; residual applicability of colonial ordinances is limited by the Belize Constitution.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: CARIFORUM-European Union Economic Partnership Agreement (signed 15 October 2008; provisional application; investment and establishment disciplines applicable to Belizean and EU investors)
CARIFORUM-United Kingdom Economic Partnership Agreement (entered into force 1 January 2021; transitional protection of investments and cross-border establishment)
Agreement Among CARICOM Member States for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (Montego Bay, 1994), implemented in Belize by the Income Tax (Caribbean Community Agreement) Act (Cap. 53)
Belize-United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement (signed 2013; provides the exchange-of-information framework relevant to the FATCA intergovernmental agreement and US tax reporting)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The principal AML/CFT statute is the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, 2019 ('MLTPA'), which repealed and replaced the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act (Cap. 104) and governs customer due diligence, reporting obligations, and the powers of the Financial Intelligence Unit of Belize. The legal framework is completed by the Anti-Terrorism Act (Cap. 107), as amended, which implements UN Security Council terrorist asset-freezing and financial sanctions, and by the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270, Rev. Ed. 2011), as amended by the International Business Companies (Amendment) Act, 2019 and the Companies (Amendment) Act, 2019. The IBC Act (in particular the provisions governing registers of directors, of members, and of beneficial owners, together with the beneficial-ownership amendment) requires every IBC to maintain at its licensed registered office a current Register of Directors, Register of Members, and Register of Beneficial Owners, and to produce such registers to the Registrar of International Business Companies or to the Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful demand. The International Financial Services Commission ('IFSC') and the IBC Registry apply binding directives, guidance notes and risk-based AML/CFT rules issued under the MLTPA and the Financial Intelligence Unit Act, as amended.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: Belize does not maintain a public UBO register. The Register of Members, Register of Directors and Register of Beneficial Owners are private, held at the office of the licensed registered agent in Belize, and are accessible only to the Registrar of International Business Companies, the Financial Intelligence Unit, the IFSC, and other Belizean competent authorities acting under lawful process. Nominee directors and nominee shareholders are permitted only where engaged through a licensed regulated agent and only where full CDD records of the nominating natural person or underlying UBO are maintained and disclosed upon demand.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's country of residence, certifying the passport issued by the competent passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Belize is a Contracting State to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961); consular legalization alternative for documents originating from non-Hague Convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address (utility bill, bank statement, or government-issued correspondence, not older than 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, retail bank, or government authority in the applicant's country of residence; notarized by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization (non-Hague Convention origin jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter addressing professional reputation, account conduct and source of funds/wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank (correspondent or domestic bank) of the applicant/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank authentication under its corporate signatory rules; notarization and apostille required for third-country bank letters

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional curriculum vitae / profile statement of each director and UBO, including economic substance narrative for the no-code SaaS activity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The individual applicant or an independent professional referee; notarized signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization for non-Hague origin; internal AML file if executed before the licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate KYC pack of each corporate shareholder or corporate UBO (Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Directors, Register of Shareholders, and Memorandum and Articles of Association)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar and registered agent of the foreign jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copies apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention or consular legalized by the Belizean diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO attestation declaration (statutory declaration of identity confirming beneficial ownership chain and absence of undisclosed principals)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Belize registered agent/AML compliance officer, witnessed by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization executed in Belize; apostille by the Belize Competent Authority where required for onward transmission

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and continuous risk-based screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and beneficial owners against (i) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, (iii) the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation consolidated list, (iv) EU restrictive measures, and (v) any list maintained by the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit or Ministry of Foreign Affairs under the MLTPA and Anti-Terrorism Act. Persons identified as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) under FATF Recommendation 12 and MLTPA definitions are subject to enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, source-of-wealth verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring. A confirmed sanctions or PEP red-flag match without credible mitigation is a mandatory refusal ground for the engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: International Business Companies Registry, a division of the International Financial Services Commission of Belize (IFSC), operating through the IFSC e-services portal and the official IFSC website (www.ifsc.gov.bz); name clearance and reservation are processed electronically via the licensed registered agent's e-filing account.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official language of Belize is English; all IBC names are registered in the Latin (Roman) alphabet. Non-English names, including Spanish or Mayan names, are admissible only where transliterated into Latin script without diacritical marks, and the Registry requires the name to be clearly distinguishable from all existing registered names and from names reserved by other applicants. The name must not be undesirable, deceptive, or suggestive of a relationship with the Government of Belize or any foreign government, and must end with a mandatory statutory suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Societe Anonyme', 'SA', or a recognized equivalent. The registered name must be identical on the Certificate of Incorporation, the seal, and all staple documents; any later transliteration change requires a formal name change filing with the IBC Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Banker, Trust, Trustee, Trust Company, Insurance, Reinsurance, Assurance, Financial, Finance, Fund, Mutual Fund, Investment, Investments, Broker, Dealer, Securities, Exchange, Clearing, Credit Union, Building Society, Savings, Money Services, Remittance, Payment, Payments

Belize, Government, National, Central, Reserve, Royal, Imperial, Commonwealth, Crown, Ministry, Authority, Police, Council, Chamber of Commerce, University, College, Institute, Red Cross, Red Crescent
Gaming, Casino, Betting, Lottery, Wagering, Sportsbook, Bookmaker
Offshore, International Business Company, IBC, Exempt, Non-Resident
Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc (permitted only as the required suffix, not as a middle or standalone descriptive token)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection notice from the IBC Registry, the applicant or the licensed registered agent must file a written administrative appeal within 14 business days of the notice, stating the grounds of objection, the proposed name amendment, and, where relevant, a letter of no-objection from the IFSC for sectoral-sensitive tokens. The Registry is required to determine the appeal within 21 business days. If the administrative appeal fails, the applicant may (i) file a new name reservation application with a fresh fee, or (ii) seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Belize under the Supreme Court of Judicature Act (Cap. 91) within 28 days of the final refusal. A validly reserved name may be re-reserved once for an additional 30-day period before expiry; if incorporation is not completed within the validity window, the reservation lapses and priority is lost.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office. The IBC Act and the IBC Registry require every IBC to maintain a physical registered office in Belize, which must be the office of a licensed registered agent appointed under the Act; the registered agent must hold the Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Beneficial Owners, and the company seal at that physical address. A virtual office or online-only correspondence address may be used only for ancillary business operations, such as customer support for the no-code website builder platform; it cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office or agent mandate. If the no-code SaaS business generates intellectual property income, the IBC must also document local substance (board meetings, local management, servers or contracted researchers in Belize) to meet the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Act, 2019 requirements for intellectual property businesses or distribution and service centre activities, as applicable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 10% annualized probability for a standard low-risk ISIC 6201 SaaS IBC with no regulated activities, no unexplained transactions, consistent tax-exempt status documentation, and a complete local substance file maintained at the registered office. The risk increases to approximately 40-60% if the IBC files an intellectual property holding election without adequate local substance evidence, or if the Financial Intelligence Unit or IFSC initiates a targeted AML/CFT examination on the basis of the client risk profile; physical inspections are typically announced through the registered agent except in suspected money-laundering cases.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: IBC name clearance and reservation application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International Financial Services Commission - International Business Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the IBC Registry Schedule of Fees applicable to name reservation filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation fee for an IBC with authorized share capital up to USD 50,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International Financial Services Commission - International Business Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee prescribed under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), as amended; higher tiers apply for authorized capital above USD 50,000.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office services, first year (including appointment, domiciliation, statutory books and compliance coordination)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark range USD 1,000-1,500 per annum per Belize licensed agent; quote reflects midpoint of the market.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence and KYC file processing per director, shareholder and UBO (passport verification, address verification, bank reference review)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent's AML compliance officer / Belize licensed regulated agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Mandatory CDD obligation under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, 2019, Part II; prevailing market flat fee per natural person.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated List and domestic sanctions screening bundle per entity and per UBO/director
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or licensed electronic screening provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market subscription-per-name fee; required under MLTPA sections 5 and 111 and the Anti-Terrorism Act (Cap. 107).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille authentication of principal KYC documents (passport, proof of address, corporate KYC pack)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in origin jurisdiction and the designated Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention (or Belizean consular post for non-Hague states)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariffs vary by origin jurisdiction; apostille fee generally USD 20-40 per document; estimate covers the standard six-document bundle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Issuance and apostille of the Certificate of Incorporation and certified true copy after registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International Business Companies Registry and the Belize Competent Authority (Apostille) / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for certified copy issuance and apostille certificate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Setup of statutory registers and company seal (Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Beneficial Owners, common seal if adopted)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market flat fee; statutory books are mandatory under the IBC Act (Cap. 270), including the beneficial-ownership record-keeping amendments.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal opinion on economic substance classification of ISIC 6201 no-code website builder SaaS activity and tax-exempt status confirmation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional benchmark for a limited-scope annual economic substance opinion under the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Act, 2019.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for consular legalization of documentation originating from non-Hague Apostille Convention jurisdictions (per document set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Belizean consular post and the ministry of foreign affairs of the document origin state
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Only triggered if KYC documents originate from a non-Hague Convention country; estimated per-document consular fee and courier handling.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize (Consolidated Edition 2020), as amended by the International Business Companies (Amendment) Acts 2019 and 2020; applicable provisions: ss. 5-14 (incorporation and constitution), s. 9 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 19-26 (share capital), ss. 30-36 (directors and officers), s. 4 (prohibition of onshore local business).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Ministry of Investment, Belmopan / Belize City; online filing portal: Belize Electronic Companies Registry (e-Registry) administered by the Registrar of Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Business Company (Form 1) together with executed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association; resulting statutory instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (Form 2).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow or paid-in capital deposit requirement. Standard practice sets authorized capital at US$50,000 (5,000 ordinary shares of US$10 each) as the zero-fee band; shares may be issued for cash, services, or promissory notes, and no capital duty is exigible at incorporation. One shareholder and one director are sufficient; non-resident ownership is expressly permitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, share subscription: that the subscription contract of the sole subscriber, covering the initial allotment of ordinary shares in the Company, be approved and ratified, and that the subscriber be entered in the Register of Members. RESOLVED, registered office: that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of its licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize, and that the registered agent be retained. RESOLVED, officers: that the first directors and officers be appointed, [Name A] as President, [Name B] as Secretary, [Name C] as Treasurer, with authority to issue shares, open bank accounts, and engage Stripe Billing and Paddle. RESOLVED, that any director be authorized to execute all documents necessary to give effect to these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) — e-Registry portal, accessed through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online name search on the e-Registry to confirm availability of the proposed corporate name for the visual web template and no-code platform business. Submit a priority reservation request; avoid statutorily restricted words (e.g., 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', 'assurance') unless separately licensed, and ensure the name does not imply a connection with the Government of Belize. Reserve the name in exact order of preference and record the reservation reference.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (primary and two alternates)
Identity of the incorporator or subscriber
Reservation application form of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or flagged as confusingly similar, file an alternative name via a fresh reservation application; if the name contains a restricted word, delete the word or obtain the relevant sectoral consent before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Belize registered agent (internal drafting and notarization)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum of Association (name clause, registered office clause, general objects clause covering software development and electronic platform services, capital clause, and subscriber provisions) and the Articles of Association (share classes, director and officer powers, meeting and indemnity provisions). The subscriber reviews, signs, and the signature is notarized or otherwise authenticated; KYC/AML due diligence is completed in accordance with Belize anti-money-laundering requirements.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of each subscriber and beneficial owner
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within three months)
Brief business profile of the no-code website builder venture
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent raises KYC/AML queries, supply enhanced due diligence (source of funds, corporate structure chart, regulatory references); if a drafting defect is identified, amend the Memorandum or Articles by subscriber written consent before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form 1 (Application for Incorporation) through the e-Registry together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered agent's consent to act, the notice of registered office, and the statutory declaration of compliance. Pay the official government filing fee of US$100 (BZ$200 equivalent) electronically. Retain the e-filing receipt evidencing lodgment date and application reference.
required_dossiers: Statutory declaration of compliance (subscriber or agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for defective execution, incomplete schedules, or payment discrepancies, cure by re-executing the affected instrument, paying any shortfall with the Registrar's invoice, and re-submitting the application through the e-Registry; expedited review may be requested from the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After substantive review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation (Form 2) under the official seal, specifying the incorporation number and date. The Belize IBC becomes a body corporate with separate legal personality and perpetual succession. Verify the certificate details against the filed constitution and record the incorporation number in the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical or typographical error, apply to the Registrar for administrative rectification by filing a corrective notice with supporting evidence; in the alternative, apply to the Supreme Court for rectification of the register under the IBC Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Allotment and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First directors of the Company (internal corporate act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or circulate a written resolution adopting the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution: ratify the subscription contract, allot the initial ordinary shares to the subscriber, approve the registered office and agent, appoint the first directors and officers, and authorize opening of bank accounts and engagement of Stripe Billing and Paddle as payment processors. Record minutes or written resolutions in the corporate minute book and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution
Share certificates issued to the subscriber
Consent to act of each director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an allotment or appointment is found defective, rescind the affected resolution and re-adopt a curative board resolution ratifying the allotment retroactively; ensure the Register of Members is corrected to reflect the valid allottee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office, Registered Agent and Statutory Registers Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent under the IBC Act; CCAR notification filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the notice of registered office and appointment of registered agent have been filed with the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry. Establish the statutory registers (members, directors, officers, charges) at the registered office in Belize City. Prepare the common seal (optional under the IBC Act) and corporate kit containing share certificates, minute book, and certified copies of constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office (Form filed with CCAR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office or agent notice was omitted or rejected, file a late notice with the Registrar accompanied by a brief explanation of default; if the registered agent is suspended, appoint a replacement licensed agent and file the change within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Maintenance Pack and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Order a Certificate of Good Standing through the e-Registry to evidence the IBC's valid existence and payment of annual fees. Retrieve certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles. Register the IBC's annual renewal calendar and pay the US$100 annual government fee before the statutory anniversary deadline to avoid late penalties and strike-off risk.
required_dossiers: Application for Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual fee is overdue and the IBC is struck off or flagged, apply for administrative restoration by paying arrears plus late penalty (typically 50 per cent of the fee) and submitting a restoration application; if struck off, follow the CCAR reinstatement procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize-licensed banks and international payment processors (Stripe Billing, Paddle)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, board resolution authorizing accounts, and the officers' identification documents, open an international bank account or activate merchant accounts with Stripe Billing and Paddle. Complete the institution's AML/KYC onboarding, including source-of-funds declaration, and execute the merchant terms, ensuring the payment data privacy terms align with the no-code platform's subscription model. IBCs are tax-exempt, so no income tax registration is required.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Board resolution authorizing account opening and payment processors
Passport copies and proof of address of directors and beneficial owner
Source of funds and source of wealth declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or payment processor rejects onboarding for enhanced due diligence, provide supplementary evidence (platform revenue projections, entity ownership chart, regulatory references) or re-route to an alternative acquiring bank or processor; if a processor requests additional registrations, complete the relevant VAT or merchant registration and submit proof to the processor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing authority is engaged for a remote no-code software platform under ISIC 6201; general commercial facilitation rests with the Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE), and voluntary product standards fall under the Belize Bureau of Standards, neither of which imposes a mandatory operating license for this activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — a Belize IBC engaged exclusively in visual web template and low-code web application building operates as an offshore digital service provider and, under s. 4 of the IBC Act, is prohibited from carrying on onshore local business in Belize; no manufacturing, trade, or industrial operating permit is exigible.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development and Climate Change, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — residual administrative/IT office activity under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations; no EIA registration or EIA Report required for purely digital, cloud-hosted operations with no physical installation, manufacturing, or data-center footprint in Belize.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater or VOC emissions are generated. Compliance thresholds: Clean Air Act (Cap. 351) nuisance-free operation; domestic wastewater routed to municipal sewerage under the Public Health Act; electrical and electronic waste, if any, handled under the Hazardous Waste Management Regulations and Basel Convention transboundary rules, through licensed recyclers; no BOD/COD or particulate discharge limits applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Belize National Fire Service, structural load inspection by the Central Building Committee, and workplace clearance from the Labour Department under the Occupational Safety and Health Act are not triggered by a virtual registered office. If a physical office or server room is opened later, the IBC must obtain a building permit, fire certificate under the Fire Services Act (Cap. 237), and an occupational safety clearance before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service, Fiscal Policy and Tax Administration Division, Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment; e-Services portal: https://taxservices.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Belize International Business Company (IBC) is registered by its licensed registered agent with the Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) under the International Business Companies Act. The IBC does not obtain a conventional Belize TIN because it is statutorily tax-exempt; instead, the IFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the registered agent applies to the Belize Tax Service for a Certificate of Tax Exemption / Non-Resident Status when required by foreign banks or correspondent institutions. If the IBC subsequently undertakes taxable activity within Belize, the registered agent must file a VAT/Employer registration application with the Belize Tax Service to obtain a TIN and VAT registration number, using the same e-Services portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (non-resident International Business Company excluded from Belize income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty on offshore transactions, and VAT on offshore digital services; no entity-level taxation in Belize).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize has no US-style check-the-box election and no statutory hybrid mismatch election. The IBC tax exemption is automatic under the IBC Act rather than elective. An IBC may elect in its constitutional documents to be non-resident and exempt from exchange control; the company may also voluntarily elect to register for VAT in Belize to recover input tax or facilitate zero-rated cross-border supplies, although such registration is not required for purely offshore business. Foreign parent entities may make their own transparency or CFC elections under their home-country tax law, but those elections are not recognized as Belize statutory tax elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 100,000 in annual taxable supplies (approx. USD 50,000); a non-resident IBC with no Belize-source supplies generally remains below the registration threshold and is not required to register for VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, online invoice stamping, SAF-T, or API-based continuous transaction controls. Registered businesses must issue a full electronic or paper VAT invoice within 30 days, file VAT returns through the Belize Tax Service e-Tax portal, retain digital ledgers, and keep export documentation available for inspection. No Belizean government API clearance is required for B2B or B2C e-invoicing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available to a VAT-registered supplier where the goods are exported from Belize within the statutory time window, or where services are supplied to a non-resident recipient and the benefit and place of supply are located outside Belize, including offshore digital and no-code software services offered by an IBC. The supplier must retain evidence that consideration is received from abroad and may claim a corresponding input VAT credit in Belize; the IBC's non-resident tax-exempt status further removes Belize VAT on foreign-derived SaaS and website builder revenue.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Validated Belize Customs Export Declaration / Export Entry
Commercial Invoice and detailed packing list
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or alternative transport evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice showing foreign exchange receipt
Non-resident customer service contract, certificates of residence, or place-of-consumption evidence for digital services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner of the Belize Tax Service may issue an assessment for unreported VAT at 12.5%, plus statutory interest and an additional penalty up to 100% of the tax due. Fraudulent zero-rating or export-refund claims also attract criminal penalties of a fine not exceeding BZD 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years under the Value Added Tax Act. Any VAT input credit or export refund is clawed back retrospectively if the exporter fails to produce the full documentation bundle, fails to bring consideration into Belize within 180 days, or is found to have mischaracterized services as offshore to obtain zero-rating.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), constituted under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Chapter 262, Revised Edition 2020); the CBB administers the Exchange Control Act (Chapter 35), issues exchange-control notices, operates the fixed 2.00 BZD/USD peg, and supervises authorized dealers. The International Financial Services Commission (IFSC), constituted under the International Financial Services Commission Act (Chapter 272), independently registers and supervises the International Business Company (IBC) for annual-license, beneficial-ownership, and economic-substance compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is convertible for current-account purposes under a rigid peg of 2.00 BZD = 1.00 USD, maintained by the CBB since 1976; capital-account transactions by BZD residents require CBB exchange-control approval. The non-resident IBC operates in a de facto unrestricted convertibility zone: the IBC Act (Chapter 270) disapplies the Exchange Control Act for foreign-currency dealings with non-residents, so the IBC may invoice in USD, hold USD/EUR/GBP accounts at authorized dealers, and remit dividends free of CBB approval and without Belize withholding tax. Residual hurdles are practical, not legal: all USD wires clear through US correspondent banks applying OFAC and sanctions screening; the IBC cannot fund in BZD from Belize residents; and annual IFSC license and registry filings must remain current to preserve non-resident, tax-exempt status. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted, with no dividend withholding and no foreign-exchange surrender obligation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory surrender rules bind only BZD residents: resident exporters must repatriate proceeds within six months and sell the full foreign-currency amount (effectively a 100% conversion obligation) to an authorized dealer within the prescribed CBB window. The non-resident IBC is exempt from all surrender timelines and conversion ratios, provided no in-scope software revenue is received in BZD from Belize residents; any such receipt would trigger the resident rules and imperil the IBC exemption. The treasury must nonetheless demand USD-denominated settlements from Paddle and Stripe Billing, annotate inbound MT103 messages as 'Export of Software Services - ISIC 6201', and retain gateway settlement reports to evidence the source and service character of all proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: IBC Multi-Currency Operational Account (USD primary, EUR/GBP sub-ledgers); optional USD Capital Escrow Account for investor subscription tranches

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Belize Bank Limited (successor to Scotiabank Belize branch operations)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: International Business Company Corporate Account (USD) with segregated operational ledger for payment-gateway settlements
Offshore Corporate Account (USD, subject to CBB policy review and minimum-balance covenant)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Constrained / Moderate-Low. Belize has no domestic electronic-money-institution or digital-bank licensing track, and the CBB does not charter pass-through fintech accounts; international EMIs generally classify Belizean IBCs as higher risk because of prior CFATF mutual-evaluation follow-up and global de-risking pressure, and the no-code model's intangible digital revenue without physical subcontracts compounds the concern. Wise and Airwallex will typically decline a pure Belize IBC without audited financials, directorship history, and 12 months of trading data; Payoneer offers limited Belizean residence onboarding but does not substitute for a corporate banking relationship. The implementable architecture is hybrid: Paddle serves as merchant of record (acquires customer cards, remits net USD by MT103), Stripe Billing is reached only through a supported-country group entity under arm's-length intercompany service agreements, and liquidity concentrates in the Belize tier-1 account to satisfy CBB supervisory expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto physical appearance is required: at least one subscriber-director (preferably the decision-maker) and the ultimate beneficial owner must attend the bank's compliance office in Belize City or San Pedro for a structured KYC/AML interview covering the ISIC 6201 business model, expected Stripe/Paddle settlement flows, and the substance footprint of the IBC. Remote opening is formally possible with a licensed Belize registered agent acting as introducer, notarized and apostilled corporate documents, and video identification, but tier-1 banks universally reserve the right to require in-person signature within 90 days; in practice, a pure remote mandate without a Belize-based introducer is rejected at all four banks listed above.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore 'tax-exempt IBC' label perceived as a shell structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IFSC Certificate of Good Standing; registered-office lease or registered-agent confirmation of physical Belize premises; board minutes locating principal management decisions in Belize; annual return and economic-substance declaration confirming non-application of a relevant activity (or, if applicable, demonstrating compliance with the 2019 economic-substance test); shareholder register; narrative business plan for the no-code website builder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Origin of funds from digital low-code subscription platforms without contractual trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Paddle merchant-of-record agreement and Stripe Billing service agreement; 6-12 months of gateway payout statements; subscriber counts and average revenue per account; sample customer subscription contracts; founder source-of-wealth declaration; management or audited accounts tying gateway receipts to ledger revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction exposure to high-risk or sanctioned counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written geoblocking and payment-fraud prevention policy; OFAC and UN sanctions plus PEP screening logs; customer KYC intake screen; list of blocked jurisdictions; board-approved sanctions compliance statement; bank reference letters from prior payment processors.

Licensed IFSC-registered-agent agreement; IFSC Certificate of Status; board minutes of meetings physically convened in Belize; engagement letter of a Belize-resident corporate secretary or director, if engaged; paid annual license fee receipts; evidence that the registered office holds corporate records and statutory registers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid pass-through flow of funds or thin treasury balances
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly treasury reconciliation linking Paddle/Stripe payouts to the IBC general ledger; annual cash-flow budget and projected gateway settlement volumes; letter of comfort from the registered agent; covenant to maintain a minimum relationship balance; segregated operational and capital ledgers to avoid commingling.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing mandates USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 wires: equity injections from founders are tagged 'Capital Contribution to BZ IBC - ISIC 6201' and must be matched to the register of members with a board resolution and capital-contribution agreement; operating revenue arrives as MT103 settlements from Paddle (merchant of record) and, where a supported-country entity is used, from Stripe Billing, tagged 'Software Subscription Sales - No-Code Site Builder'. Each inbound credit is screened against CBB AML/CFT reporting thresholds; the receiving banker requires gateway settlement reports, underlying subscriber invoices, and a source-of-funds declaration for wires above the bank's reporting threshold. All injections are recorded as paid-in surplus and disclosed in the annual IFSC return to preserve the tax-exempt classification; the IBC must not receive BZD from Belize residents, and no cash currency should be physically transported into Belize.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for cloud hosting, domain renewals, subcontracted software development, IFSC agent fees, and professional services execute via SWIFT MT103 direct credits from the IBC's USD account through the Belize bank's US correspondent network with standard 1-3 business-day value dating; BZD clearing is unavailable to the non-resident IBC, and any local Belize-dollar expense must be converted through the authorized dealer at the 2:1 peg. Commercial letters of credit (MT700) are legally available but economically unsuitable for SaaS disbursements; the governing rail is open-account MT103 with a dated invoice and underlying contract retained for audit. Related-party payments require arm's-length documentation under Belize transfer-pricing principles, and all outbound wires above the bank's threshold demand board authorization recorded in minutes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/EUR and USD/GBP to lock Paddle and Stripe settlement conversions where the gateway remits in non-USD currency
Deliverable outright FX forwards with the Belize authorized dealer for hedged conversion of excess EUR/GBP balances into USD
Cross-currency swaps with OECD-listed counterparties for matched funding of EUR-denominated operating expenses
Vanilla FX options and zero-cost collars on USD/EUR for long-dated subscription revenue exceeding USD 250,000 annual net settlement
Natural hedging through a multi-currency (USD/EUR/GBP) sub-ledger to minimize conversion frequency and spread costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual IBC Registration Fee (Annual Government License and Renewal Fee; standard tier for authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: International Business Companies Registry, Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize (administered through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year basis: the fee for the initial year is pro-rated and paid at incorporation; each subsequent annual fee falls due on 1 January and is payable through the registered agent, with the standard administrative cut-off on 31 January before late-payment penalties accrue.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty of 10% of the overdue fee per month or part of a month in default; continuing non-payment after Registrar notice leads to administrative strike-off under section 142 of the International Business Companies Act, loss of the certificate of good standing, vesting of corporate assets in the Government of Belize, and a restoration process requiring payment of arrears, penalties, and restoration fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Record Update and Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies and International Business Companies, under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2017 (as amended); data is filed by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Event-driven filing: any change in beneficial ownership must be lodged with the Registrar within 14 days of the IBC becoming aware of the change. No standalone calendar-year UBO return is prescribed, but the registered agent requires an annual written UBO confirmation aligned with the renewal cycle to keep the Registry record current.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance constitutes an offence under the Beneficial Ownership Act; the IBC and each defaulting director or officer are exposed to fines and daily default penalties, loss of good standing with the registered agent, and adverse impact on banking and payment-rail (Stripe, Paddle) due diligence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification / Tax-Residence Declaration (Conditional — Not Applicable to Standard Tax-Exempt IBC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: International Business Companies Registry / competent national authority (only where the IBC becomes tax-resident in Belize)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No filing is due for an IBC that is tax-exempt and managed, controlled, and tax-resident outside Belize, which is the default profile of this entity. A notification becomes due within the statutory period after the accounting reference year only if the IBC acquires Belize tax residence or undertakes a relevant activity with substance failures.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The standard tax-exempt non-resident IBC has no economic substance sanction exposure; an in-scope Belize-tax-resident entity that fails to file is subject to financial penalties, officer liability, and potential exchange-of-information consequences under the OECD framework.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Belize IBC is statutorily exempt from independent audit and from filing audited financial statements with the Registry; no capital, revenue, or size threshold triggers a mandatory audit under the IBC Act. An audit may be requested voluntarily by a financier, investor, or contract, but never by the corporate registry.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed on IBCs. Where financial statements are prepared voluntarily, IFRS is the prevailing standard in Belize; the IBC Act only requires that records adequate to reflect transactions and financial position be kept at the registered office.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2017 (as amended), the IBC must maintain an accurate register of beneficial owners and the registered agent must file any change with the Registrar within 14 days of the IBC becoming aware. Although no standalone annual UBO return is mandated, the licensed registered agent performs an annual re-confirmation exercise (typically coordinated with the 1 January renewal) to verify UBO details and to confirm that share transfers, if any, are correctly reflected in the Register of Members and in the Registry's electronic UBO record.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (directors' and members' meeting minutes)
Accounting Records (sufficient to reflect the IBC's financial position)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,200 per annum (typical licensed registered agent and registered office retainer in Belize)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,500 per engagement (voluntary certified audit or financial statement preparation; no statutory audit is imposed on a standard IBC)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a qualifying International Business Company (IBC Act, Cap. 270, s. 6); 25% general corporate rate under the Income and Business Tax Act, 2023 for resident companies that have not elected IBC exempt status
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 50-year exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, business tax, estate tax, stamp duty and withholding tax (IBC Act s. 6(1)-(2)); foreign-source revenue from the no-code website-builder activity (ISIC 6201 / NAICS 511210) earned through Stripe/Paddle is not Belize-source income unless the IBC carries on business through a Belize fixed establishment; no exchange control restrictions; no capital duty or minimum capital requirement

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (Form ESR-1) - filed electronically through the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) online portal (www.ifsc.gov.bz) and shared with the Belize Tax Service Department
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the relevant financial period (IBC financial period equals the accounting period stated to IFSC, usually the 12 months following incorporation)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, incorporation number, tax residency status, financial period start and end dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Belize IBC is deemed tax resident in Belize for ESR purposes solely by incorporation; facts of management and control must be disclosed consistently

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of relevant activity: intellectual property business, distribution and service center, headquarters, pure equity holding company, or 'no relevant activity'
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A no-code website builder owning proprietary software and earning subscription/licence revenue must classify as 'intellectual property business'; a reseller of third-party templates without software ownership may classify as 'distribution and service center'

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income earned from the relevant activity, broken down by source jurisdiction
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income connected to the declared relevant activity; intercompany dividends, interest and capital gains remain tax-exempt

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees in Belize, physical premises in Belize, operating expenditure incurred in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remote staff abroad do not count; the IBC must itself maintain Belize premises, payroll and decision-making records for the software business

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E - IP nexus (modified nexus approach)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGAs) for IP: strategic R&D, branding, development, exploitation contracts, legal ownership of code and trademarks
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Qualifying R&D expenditure ratio must support the IP income; an IBC with zero Belize R&D fails the nexus test automatically

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of accuracy signed by a director and countersigned by the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False declarations trigger personal criminal liability of the signing director even if offshore

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or satisfy the economic substance test: fine up to BZD 250,000 (about USD 125,000), daily default fines, automatic exchange of information with the beneficial owner's tax authority, and strike-off of the IBC

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return (Form AR-IBC) - filed electronically by the licensed Belize registered agent through the IFSC online entity registry
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after the anniversary of incorporation (International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, s. 166, as amended in 2018)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part 1 - Registered agent and registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number and address of the Belize registered agent; registered office address in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners cannot change the registered agent without IFSC notice; the agent must remain licensed under the Banks and Financial Institutions Act

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities and service addresses of all current directors
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident natural persons; nominee directors must have written declarations and disclosed ultimate controllers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, share classes, and ultimate beneficial ownership details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership data is held on the IFSC confidential registry; bearer shares are prohibited for new IBCs and must be immobilized

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, par value, and whether capital is paid up
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital is required for the IBC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement that the IBC has not carried on domestic Belize business (banking, insurance, real estate, local services) and is compliant with the Act
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Selling SaaS globally to non-residents is permitted; selling to Belize residents or holding Belize real estate breaks the exempt status

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of BZD 1,000 plus continuing default penalties; repeated non-filing leads to administrative dissolution, loss of separate legal personality, nullification of the 50-year tax exemption, and restoration fees

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - dividends and capital distributions paid by an IBC to non-resident shareholders are statutorily exempt from all Belize withholding taxes (IBC Act s. 6(1)(b)); Belize domestic law imposes no separate dividend withholding tax on distributions by a compliant IBC
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief claim is required because the source-state rate is already zero. Where a foreign shareholder wishes to claim an indirect foreign tax credit or treaty protection, the shareholder must: (1) make a written application to the Belize Tax Service Department (TSD) on the certificate-of-residence application form; (2) present the IBC certificate of incorporation and ESR/Annual Return compliance proof; (3) obtain a Belize Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) - issued in practice only where the IBC demonstrates management and control in Belize and positive tax liability; (4) attach the TRC to the foreign treaty claim form (e.g., HMRC Double Taxation Relief claim under the Belize-UK DTA 2016; CARICOM Multilateral Agreement forms). A fully tax-exempt IBC will generally be denied a TRC because the DTA network (Belize-UK, CARICOM) requires residence based on taxable presence
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for royalty, licence and interest payments made by an IBC to non-resident payees (IBC Act exemption). Payments received by the IBC from Stripe/Paddle for the no-code website-builder service are gross subscription income sourced where the recipient performs its activities and are not subject to Belize withholding tax. For domestic taxable companies under the Income and Business Tax Act, 2023, payments of royalties and interest to non-residents may attract general-law withholding subject to DTA reduction; this regime does not apply to a non-electing IBC

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BZD 2,000,000 (approximately USD 1,000,000) aggregate annual cross-border related-party transactions within the IBC group - administrative OECD-aligned threshold used by the Belize Tax Service Department Transfer Pricing Guidelines; a Master File is expected where the ultimate group's consolidated revenue exceeds BZD 400,000,000 (approximately USD 200,000,000); country-by-country reporting applies on a best-efforts basis to MNE groups exceeding the OECD EUR 750,000,000 threshold
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Tax Information Exchange (Economic Substance) Act, 2019 applies to every Belize-resident IBC carrying on a 'relevant activity'. A no-code website builder holding proprietary software is an 'intellectual property business'; a template reseller or infrastructure-only operator may be a 'distribution and service center'. The IBC must show in Belize: (1) direction and management of the activity; (2) performance of core income-generating activities; (3) adequate employees, premises, and operating expenditure. IP businesses must also satisfy the OECD modified nexus test (nexus ratio of qualifying expenditure). Pure equity-holding IBCs benefit from a reduced substance test. A solo founder operating remotely with no Belize office, employees, or board meetings in Belize will fail the ESR test and trigger automatic information exchange

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: IBC earning SaaS/licensing revenue from the no-code website-builder activity while having no physical premises, no employees, no expenditure and no core income-generating activities in Belize; failing to file Form ESR-1 within 12 months of the financial year-end or falsely declaring 'no relevant activity'
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to BZD 250,000 (about USD 125,000) for significant non-compliance; daily default penalties up to BZD 10,000; mandatory automatic exchange of information with the tax authority of the beneficial owner; administrative strike-off and loss of the 50-year tax exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are personally liable for economic substance offences, including imprisonment up to 3 years for false declarations; civil restitution orders may attach to personal assets; the registered agent may be deregistered and the director subject to a travel ban where the IBC founder is assessed as a shadow director

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a false IBC Annual Return or ESR declaration; knowingly concealing beneficial ownership; diverting global subscription revenue through personal accounts while claiming Belize exempt status; carrying on prohibited Belize domestic business (e.g., selling services to Belize residents) without electing taxable status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to BZD 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Income and Business Tax Act, 2023 and the IBC Act; forfeiture of the statutory exemption; retroactive assessment of 25% corporate tax on deemed Belize-source income plus interest and late-payment penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: directors, shareholder-directors and shadow directors may be jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt; civil recovery and confiscation proceedings under the Proceeds of Crime Act; travel bans, restraint orders and extradition exposure for aggravated evasion

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to disclose ultimate beneficial owners to the IFSC confidential registry; operating with unregistered nominee shareholders; accepting Stripe/Paddle settlements without proper CDD/KYC; structuring payments to circumvent the monetary threshold reporting obligations under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act (as amended)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines from BZD 10,000 up to BZD 100,000 per infraction; suspension of the IBC certificate; mandatory disclosure to the Financial Intelligence Unit; blacklisting of the IBC's bank and payment-rail accounts; potential confiscation of funds held in the Stripe/Paddle settlement account
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Money laundering is a predicate offence carrying imprisonment up to 14 years and unlimited fines; directors, compliance officers and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability even where the corporate entity is struck off; travel bans and international freezing orders commonly accompany prosecution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late Filing / Non-Payment of Government Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IBC Annual Return within 60 days of the incorporation anniversary and non-payment of the annual IFSC licence fee; ignoring IFSC notices regarding ESR filing obligations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late filing surcharge of BZD 1,000 with continuing monthly penalties; administrative dissolution of the IBC after continued default; after dissolution the company loses legal capacity to enforce its SaaS agreements, hold IP registrations, or maintain the Stripe/Paddle merchant contract
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who contract on behalf of a dissolved IBC may be personally liable on those contracts; the registered agent may resign, triggering conversion to a non-compliant entity and exposure of the beneficial owner to personal liability for post-dissolution liabilities
